components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Solid carbon-ink boxboard button with uppercase monospace label and square-stroke arrow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 47px; padding: 11px 22px; background: var(--ink, #0e0d0b); color: var(--tissue, #f6f4ef); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #141210); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 13.4px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #231e19; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e0d0b; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f6f4ef; }

components.name: Secondary Kraft Button
components.description: Bordered burnt-kraft button that inverts to carbon ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 47px; padding: 11px 22px; background: var(--kraft, #d07a3a); color: var(--ink, #0e0d0b); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #141210); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 13.4px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #0e0d0b; color: #f6f4ef; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e0d0b; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f6f4ef; }

components.name: Archive Wall Box End-Label Tab
components.description: Interactive box-end cell with top semicircular finger notch, ruled spec row, technical stamp glyph, and four-colorway strip.
components.css: .ds-stack-box { position: relative; width: 320px; background: var(--kraft, #d07a3a); color: var(--ink, #0e0d0b); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #141210); padding: 18px 12px 13px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 10px; align-items: end; gap: 10px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stack-box:hover { background: var(--kraft-face, #d78243); } .ds-stack-box:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e0d0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-notch { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 46%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 38px; height: 11px; background: #0e0d0b; border-radius: 0 0 19px 19px; } .ds-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sub { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.7px; color: #1e1107; } .ds-run { margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(20,18,16,0.28); font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-mark { width: 40px; height: 40px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.35; align-self: center; } .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr); width: 10px; height: 64px; border: 1px solid #141210; } .ds-strip i:nth-child(1) { background: #4c6c44; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #f6f4ef; } .ds-strip i:nth-child(2) { background: #446685; } .ds-strip i:nth-child(3) { background: #684b8c; } .ds-strip i:nth-child(4) { background: #b13a2e; }

components.name: Size-Run Estimator Chip
components.description: Tabular monospace item-count selector chip used in the Digital Menu rupee estimator.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { min-width: 42px; min-height: 35px; padding: 4px 10px; background: #f6f4ef; color: #0e0d0b; border: 1.5px solid #141210; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #d78243; } .ds-chip.is-selected { background: #0e0d0b; color: #f6f4ef; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e0d0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dispatch Form Input Field
components.description: Tissue-mounted project enquiry input field with monospace label and Steel Blue focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; padding: 14px; background: #f6f4ef; border: 1.5px solid #141210; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.2px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0e0d0b; } .ds-input { min-height: 47px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #141210; border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff; color: #0e0d0b; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; caret-color: #b13a2e; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5a4f46; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #446685; outline: 2px solid #0e0d0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Madeform's visual identity rejects the soft pastel agency template and the cold frosted-glass SaaS shell in favor of tactile hospitality packaging craft. The surface behaves like a floor-to-ceiling wall of burnt-orange archive boxes in a specialty roastery or bakery backroom: every offering, rupee figure, and live concept is indexed on the end of a cardboard box by tall compressed grotesque capitals, a horizontal ruled spec line, a technical stamp glyph, and a four-swatch colorway strip. When a visitor inspects an item, the drawer physically slides out of its recessed dark cubby cavity, exposing a three-dimensional cardboard side wall and multi-faceted folded white tissue paper cradling the real work inside.

Density is architectural and rule-governed. Rather than floating cards over empty neutral margins, containers share continuous 1.5px ink rules across a committed burnt-orange kraft ground (#d07a3a). Pacing alternates between the dense indexed box wall of the opening viewport, a dark carbon-lined exhibition case (#141210) that gives café photography dramatic contrast, unboxed tissue-lined package slabs (#f6f4ef) with an interactive rupee calculator, a calm unboxed editorial ledger for studio principles, and a tissue-paper project dispatch form.
keyCharacteristics: Committed burnt-orange kraft boxboard ground (#d07a3a) ruled edge-to-edge by 1.5px ink hairlines (#141210).
Pulled-open 3D cardboard tray inside a recessed dark cubby well with skewed cardboard return walls, top finger-notch cutouts, and multi-fold white tissue paper planes (#f6f4ef).
Four-swatch vertical colorway strips (Forest #4c6c44, Steel Blue #446685, Violet #684b8c, Brick #b13a2e) indexing every package and concept box.
Tall compressed uppercase display typography (Anton) paired with condensed box-end headers (Barlow Condensed), tabular monospace pricing specs (Chivo Mono), and clean humanist reading copy (Barlow).
Persistent left index rail on desktop (7.35rem wide) that collapses cleanly to a ruled sticky top bar on tablet and mobile (<=900px).

rules.name: The Tinted Umber Rule
rules.body: Never place neutral gray text on burnt-orange kraft board; all secondary text on kraft uses deep roasted umber (#1e1107) so shadows and captions belong to the cardboard material and exceed 4.5:1 AA contrast.

rules.name: The Tissue Interior Rule
rules.body: Pure white and off-white (#f6f4ef) never appear as outer page backgrounds; they are reserved strictly for the interior lining of opened boxes, specimen frames, and dispatch slips resting on the kraft ground.

rules.name: The Colorway Strip Rule
rules.body: The four accent hues (#4c6c44, #446685, #684b8c, #b13a2e) travel together as a vertical four-part colorway bar on box ends, with a 1.5px white inner inset box-shadow marking which variant owns that box.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry a small kicker, badge, or eyebrow label above them; section titles and process headings stand on their own weight, and sequential indices (01–04) occupy a separate structural grid column beside the heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Rupee Rule
rules.body: Every price (₹2,999, From ₹7,999, +₹50), item count, and phone number (+91 63014 38905) sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so figures align across box ends, calculators, and comparison rows.

rules.name: The One-Drawer Depth Rule
rules.body: Only the pulled-open archive drawer (.pulled-drawer) projects in 3D space with skewed cardboard side walls and a cast drop shadow; all shelved boxes, package slabs, and form containers sit flat in the ruled 1.5px grid and respond to hover with a crisp -1px to -3px vertical lift.

dos: Do keep #d07a3a burnt-orange kraft as the dominant page ground and use 1.5px solid #141210 rules to divide regions edge-to-edge.
Do include the semicircular top finger-notch (.box-notch), the horizontal dividing rule above the bottom tabular spec row, and the four-part .colorway-strip on every archive box face.
Do self-host all four font voices (Anton, Barlow Condensed, Chivo Mono, Barlow) in ./fonts/ to preserve zero third-party font requests and zero tracking cookies.
Do keep all functional UI text and monospace labels at or above 0.72rem (11.5px).
donts: Don't place eyebrow badges, kickers, or STEP 01 pills above headings; integrate sequential numbers into a dedicated structural grid column (.step-index).

Don't add transition: background-color to button.stack-box tabs adjacent to the 3D drawer, or float .pulled-drawer with position: absolute over static background boxes where icons or notches get partially clipped.
Don't introduce rounded SaaS pills (999px), frosted-glass blur (backdrop-filter), gradient text, hard brutalist 4px 4px 0 offset shadows, or hand-sketched doodle SVGs.
